news.title: GTA VI is out now
news.summary: Take-Two confirmed the game is available today on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, sold through the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store and retailers. It is rated M for Mature.

news.title: Official soundtrack album released
news.summary: A companion album with 34 original tracks is out on major streaming services from launch, with vinyl and CD editions also available.

news.title: Launch set for November 19, 2026
news.summary: The publisher moved launch from May 26 to November 19, 2026, saying the team needed more time to finish the game.

news.title: Trailer 2 released
news.summary: The second trailer gave a longer look at both leads, more of the state of Leonida, and the game's tone.

news.title: First release date announced
news.summary: A launch date of May 26, 2026 was announced. It was later pushed back to November.

news.title: Trailer 1 revealed
news.summary: The first trailer introduced Lucia and the Vice City setting inside the fictional state of Leonida.

guides.title: Launch Day Prep
guides.subtitle: Get your console ready so you're playing the minute it unlocks.
guides.body:
## Before launch
- **Free up storage.** Big open-world games need a lot of space, and patches add more. Clear room well before launch day.
- **Update your console.** Install system updates now so they don't hold you up at midnight.
- **Turn on automatic downloads.** On PlayStation, enable Rest Mode downloads. On Xbox, use Energy Saving or Sleep with updates on.
- **Pre-load if you bought digital.** If pre-loading is offered, start it as soon as it opens.
## On launch night
- **Expect a day-one patch.** Leave time for it to download before you play.
- **Use a wired connection** if you can. It is usually faster and steadier than Wi-Fi.
- **Check the official site** for the exact unlock time in your region.

guides.title: What We Know So Far
guides.subtitle: The confirmed basics, with no rumors mixed in.
guides.body:
## The basics
- **Release:** November 19, 2026
- **Platforms:** PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S at launch
- **Setting:** Vice City and the surrounding state of Leonida, a fictional take on Florida
- **Leads:** Lucia and Jason, shown together in the trailers
## Not confirmed yet
Anything not listed above should be treated as unconfirmed. In the Home tab, rumors are always labeled RUMOR.

guides.title: How to Use This App
guides.subtitle: Countdown, timeline, guides and your personal tracker.
guides.body:
## Home
A live countdown, a launch-day reminder you can switch on, and a timeline of announcements. Each item is labeled **Official**, **Rumor** or **Community**.
## Guides
New guides are added after launch, with no app update needed. Pull down on any screen to refresh.
## Tracker
Tap items to check them off. Your progress is saved on your phone.
## Widget
Add the Launch Countdown widget to your Home Screen to see the days left at a glance.

guides.title: Fixing Up Jason's House
guides.subtitle: An early optional task that makes a good first impression on Lucia.
guides.body:
## When it appears
After Lucia calls Jason to say she's being released, you can patch up his place before you pick her up. It's optional, but she notices the work when she arrives and it helps your relationship with her.
## The repairs
Each job shows a paintbrush icon nearby. Walk up and interact to do it. Any order works.
- **Roof:** climb the ladder beside the front door and fix the tarp-covered patch on top.
- **Steps:** head down to the driveway where the car is parked and use the pile of planks at the bottom of the stairs.
- **Bedroom wall:** inside, board up the open wall in Jason's bedroom, then use the paint buckets to finish it.
- **Railing:** out on the deck by the workout gear, fix the broken railing.
## Tip
Do these while you wait for the call to pick Lucia up, along with the other optional errands for her return. They all count toward a better start with her.

missions.title: Coming Home
missions.summary: Lucia is finally released, and Jason picks her up and takes her out to celebrate with friends. The night doesn't stay calm for long.
steps: Optional: run errands for Lucia's return, like picking up her clothes, a gift and flowers, and getting a haircut.
When Lucia calls, drive to the prison and check in with the guard at reception.
Meet Lucia outside and get in the car together.
Drive to **The Rusty Anchor** bar and head inside.
Order drinks, then find Lucia and talk to her.
Mingle with your friends at the bar.
Dance with Lucia if you want to.
Play a game of pool with Mattia.
Take the confrontation outside and win the fistfight.
Run from the police with Lucia to finish.
tips: The pre-mission errands and the house repairs are optional, but they give Jason and Lucia's relationship a better start.
Accepting the dance gives a small relationship boost.
In the fight, block when your opponent starts winding up, then hit back.

missions.title: Buck Me
missions.summary: Jason tries to open a bank account and ends up with the BuckMe app instead.
steps: After Lucia calls, drive to the **Fleeca** bank in Key Lento.
Ask the teller about opening an account.
Talk to the manager and follow him into his office.
Watch the cutscene back at home.
Open your phone and launch the **BuckMe** app.
From the checking account, move the $100 welcome deposit into **Family Savings**.
tips: Money in Family Savings can't be withdrawn, but you also can't lose it.
You can deposit cash at ATMs through BuckMe, which protects it if you die.
Reaching savings goals unlocks discounts and raises your checking limit.
